decisions.ask: The late-fee code and its test are written and pass, but not committed: the loan file holds a change I did not make.

recommended.door: Say "commit the late-fee code and its test": I commit only those two files; the loan file's change stays pending.
recommended.why: This is a judgment: it commits only what this delivery wrote, on your words, and can be undone.
recommended.reverses_if: the loan file's change belongs to this task or you want it committed with the rest

others.what_it_does: You commit or revert the loan file's change first, then ask me to commit the two new files.

decisions.if_none: Nothing is committed; all files stay as they are.
